name: Creeped Out
description: A masked figure known as "The Curious" collects tales of dark magic, otherworldly encounters and twisted technology in this kids anthology series.

videos.title: Slapstick
videos.overview: Have you ever been embarrassed by your family? Have you ever wished they were different people? Jessie is fed up with her embarrassing family and makes a deal with a worrisome puppet.

videos.title: Cat Food
videos.overview: Have you ever wondered what might be going on behind closed doors? A door just across the street might have behind it something you wouldn't want to get within a mile of. Stu tricks his mum into giving him a day off sick from school, but just what is that creepy old lady opposite up to?

videos.title: Trolled
videos.overview: If you had a chance to do something totally anonymously, and no one would ever find out, just how far would you push it?  Sam has a promising future ahead of him at school, but his anonymous posts on the school social media site could be his downfall.

videos.title: Marti
videos.overview: If you give your life over to technology, how long before it gives itself over to you? Kym just wants to be like the other girls in high school, but the arrival of her perfect new phone starts to unravel everything.

videos.title: A Boy Called Red
videos.overview: Do you believe in fate? Is there really something out there shaping our every decision? Or are we the ones in charge of shaping our own future? Vincent takes a trip back to his father's family home, but as he checks out the house he finds there is something unexplained lurking in the cellar.

videos.title: The Call
videos.overview: Have you ever felt uncomfortable in your own skin? What if there were a reason for that? One that you wished you never went searching for...  Pearl dreams of the sea, she sees it and hears it - but what is it that is calling her?

videos.title: Bravery Badge
videos.overview: You know that feeling - when you get something stuck in your head. What if it was really stuck? And there was nothing you could do to get it out? On a girl scout trip to the most remote woodland, Dent really wishes she could call a cab home.

videos.title: Spaceman
videos.overview: Being away from home is scary enough. But imagine if home was on the other side of the universe, and you had no idea how you were ever going to get back. Spud and Thomas go for a ramble through the woods looking for a den but they find so much more than that.

videos.title: Kindlesticks
videos.overview: Did you have an imaginary friend? Do you wonder whether they were so imaginary after all? If it's true for one of them, surely it's true for all of them. Maybe it's still standing right next to you now. Esme, the world's worst babysitter, takes a job with a nice new family. However, this time she could be out-foxed.

videos.title: Shed No Fear
videos.overview: Do you have a shed? A cellar? Anywhere dark? A place where things can hide in the shadows, watching, waiting. Are you sure you don't have a shade lurking in your home right now? Greg has a hunch that all is not well with his friend Dave. When he follows him to his aunt's shed, the adventure is only just beginning.

videos.title: The Traveller
videos.overview: Some people believe that if you do something bad, then eventually something bad will happen to you. But what if it wasn't just an invisible force but a being, a creature that you couldn't outrun? Jodie and Brandon find themselves stuck in-between time, and they are not alone.

videos.title: Side Show Part One
videos.overview: How much do you trust your memories? Are you so sure they're real? Are you willing to bet your life upon them? We meet Ace, our amazing aromatologist in an old-fashioned circus, but just how did he get there and where does he really belong?

videos.title: Side Show Part Two
videos.overview: Mysterious stories. As Ace starts to make sense of his few memories of his past, a plan comes together to get him home, but plans don't always go to plan.

videos.title: One More Minute
videos.overview: There's nothing wrong with playing video games. But how long is too long to play?

videos.title: Itchy
videos.overview: When headlice begin to infest his small town, Gabe may be the only person who can help.

videos.title: Help
videos.overview: Artificial intelligence can be helpful. But does it have access to too much information?

videos.title: The Many Place
videos.overview: Three siblings on a rainy vacation in Australia explore their mysterious hotel.

videos.title: The Unfortunate Five
videos.overview: What if instead of punishment you had yoga and mindfulness exercises?

videos.title: No Filter
videos.overview: When selfie-obsessed Kiera downloads an app to erase all her flaws, a shocking side effect sends her running to her tech-savvy sister for help.

videos.title: Only Child
videos.overview: When Mia's baby brother comes home from the hospital, strange things start happening around the house -- and Mia gets all the blame.

videos.title: The Takedown
videos.overview: Just as Alexa gets a chance to compete against the boys for a spot at wrestling regionals, a mysterious text message offers her a special "gift."

videos.title: Tilly Bone
videos.overview: Vlogger Cass's birthday sleepover ended in disaster. But why? Rewind through the footage for clues.

videos.title: Splinta Claws
videos.overview: A holiday mishap leaves friends Lawrence and Mikey locked in a department store after closing time -- with a creepy mechanical Santa on their trail.
